items.headline: $ASTER Crashes 32% as CEO Blames 'Malicious' Liquidations
items.summary: $ASTER plunged ~32% from its intraday spike on Aster and Binance. CEO Leonard called the liquidations 'likely malicious' and said the team is investigating.

items.headline: $OCEAN Payouts Flow to Address Flagged in Mining Hijack
items.summary: Two confirmed Bitcoin payouts totaling ~$10,500 reached a flagged address, while $OCEAN's reward system keeps assigning it a share of future blocks.

items.headline: Hyperliquid Whale Loses $10M, Rotates Into $SOL Bet
items.summary: A Hyperliquid whale that lost $10M has shifted sizable bets toward $SOL, signaling renewed leveraged conviction in Solana.

items.headline: $AVAX Alone Sees ETF Inflows as LINK, DOT Bleed
items.summary: Chainlink and Polkadot spot ETFs posted weekly outflows, while $AVAX was the only altcoin ETF recording inflows — a quiet accumulation signal.

items.headline: Vestige Shuts Algorand DeFi Platform, $ALGO Ecosystem Hit
items.summary: Vestige will close its Algorand DeFi platform on Dec. 31, 2026, citing costs — a blow to the $ALGO DeFi ecosystem.
